[align=center][i][u]_C__________H__________E__________E__________S__________E_[/u][/i][/align]
[align=center][b][u]Military Vehicle Purchase Section[/u][/b][/align]

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] Italian Dutch will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any of the Emu 2-A or Emu Herder to other nations without first getting permission from the council of Nordiheim with the exeption of active members of the THEP.

[align=center]+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++[/align]
[align=center][b][u]Continuation of the Resource Deal.[/u][/b][/align]
[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim opens its resource market for Coal to Italian Dutch for them to buy this resourses with currency of equal value from the large Nordiheimian mining company 'Vestland Gruver N.A.S.'

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] Italian Dutch opens its resource market for Copper to Nordiheim for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value from the Italian Dutch mining companies.

[u][b]2.c:[/b][/u] The Value of the Coal and Copper will be based on world market prices that will be agreed on in quarterly intervalls together with the quantities of each resource.

[align=center][b][u]Civilian Section.[/u][/b][/align]
[b][u]3.a:[/u][/b] Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

[b][u]3.c:[/u][/b] Italian Dutch will be allowed to buy from Nordiheims large range of exotic fruits, steel products and precious stones.
